query.commandtext: SELECT PROGRAM, --PRODUCT, PARAM_INDEX AS ITEM_NUMBER, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_DESC, DECODE(LSL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,LSL) as LOWER_LIMIT, DECODE(USL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,USL) as UPPER_LIMIT, DECODE(LCL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,LCL) as DIS_LOWER, DECODE(UCL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,UCL) as DIS_UPPER, UOM AS UNIT--, DIRECTION, COMMENTS FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE TESTAREA = 'PARAMETRIC' AND PROGRAM= :program

/***************************************************************** SELECT DISTINCT PARAM_NAME AS ITEM FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE PROGRAM=:program AND TESTAREA=:testArea AND PRODUCT=:product ******************************************************************/
SELECT DISTINCT PARAM_NAME, DECODE(PARAM_DESC, NULL, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_DESC) AS PARAM_DESC FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :program ORDER BY PARAM_NAME ASC

INSERT INTO TQP_PARASPEC(FACTORY, PROGRAM, PROGRAM_REV, PARAM_INDEX, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_TYPE, PARAM_DESC, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, TABLE_NAME, DECIMAL_PLACES, RUNTIME_DEFINED, UOM, USE_FLAG) VALUES (:factory, :program, :progrev, :param_index, :param_name, :param_type, :param_desc, SYSDATE, :create_user, :table_name, :decimal_places, :runtime_defined, :uom, :use_flag)
DELETE FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE PROGRAM = :program
UPDATE TQP_PARASPEC SET PROGRAM = 'UPDATE_TEMP' WHERE PROGRAM = :program

/***************************************************************** SELECT PARAM_NAME as "Item", PARAM_DESC as "Description" , DECODE(LSL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,LSL) as "Lower Limit" , DECODE(USL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,USL) as "Upper Limit" , DECODE(LCL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,LCL) as "Lower Ctl Limit" , DECODE(UCL,1E37,1E18,-1E37,-1E18,UCL) as "Upper Ctl Limit" , UOM as "Unit"--, DIRECTION as "Direction", COMMENTS FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE PROGRAM = :program *******************************************************************/
SELECT FACTORY, PROGRAM, PROGRAM_REV, PARAM_INDEX, PARAM_NAME, USER_PROGRAM_NAME, PARAM_TYPE, PARAM_DESC, TO_CHAR(CREATE_TIME, 'YY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_TIME, 'YY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, TABLE_NAME, DECIMAL_PLACES, RUNTIME_DEFINED, DECODE(USE_FLAG, 'Y', 'True', 'False') AS USE_FLAG, UOM, LSL, TARGET, USL, LCL, UCL, LOL, UOL, LTL, UTL, TEST_LOW, TEST_HIGH FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :program AND program_rev = (SELECT MAX (PROGRAM_REV) FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :program) ORDER BY PARAM_INDEX
DELETE FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE PROGRAM='UPDATE_TEMP'
UPDATE TQP_PARASPEC SET PROGRAM = :program WHERE PROGRAM = 'UPDATE_TEMP'
-- Create Date : 2019-05-24 09:57:11 SELECT MAX (program_rev) AS "MAX_VALUE" FROM tqp_paraspec WHERE 1 = 1 AND factory = :factory AND program = :program
SELECT * FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :pgm AND PROGRAM_REV IN (??) AND PARAM_INDEX > 1 AND TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY PARAM_NAME

WITH WT AS ( SELECT A.* FROM TQP_PARASPEC A, TQP_WAFER B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PROGRAM = :pgm AND B.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND A.PARAM_TYPE IN ('FLOAT', 'INT' ) AND A.PROGRAM_REV = B.PROGRAM_REV AND A.TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL) SELECT A.* FROM WT A, ALL_TAB_COLUMNS B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.PARAM_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY DECODE(A.PARAM_NAME, 'X', 1, 'Y', 2, 'BIN', 3), A.PARAM_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT ITEM AS PARAM_NAME, ROUND(MIN (RAW_VALUE) OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM), 5) AS MIN, ROUND(MAX (RAW_VALUE) OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM), 5) AS MAX, ROUND(AVG (RAW_VALUE) OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM), 5) AS AVG FROM (WITH RAWDATA AS (SELECT ?? FROM (SELECT WAFER_SEQ, WAFER_ID FROM TQP_WAFER) T1, ??) SELECT * FROM RAWDATA UNPIVOT (RAW_VALUE FOR ITEM IN (??))) ORDER BY DECODE(PARAM_NAME, 'X', 1, 'Y', 2, 'BIN', 3), PARAM_NAME

-- Create Date : 2019-06-13 19:06:39 SELECT DISTINCT TABLE_NAME, PARAM_NAME, DECODE(PARAM_DESC, NULL, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_DESC) AS PARAM_DESC FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :program AND PROGRAM_REV = :rev ORDER BY PARAM_NAME ASC

SELECT PARAM_NAME FROM ( SELECT PROGRAM_REV, MAX(PROGRAM_REV) OVER (PARTITION BY FACTORY, PROGRAM) MAX_REV, PARAM_INDEX, PARAM_NAME FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM AND TABLE_NAME = :TABLE_NAME ) WHERE PROGRAM_REV = MAX_REV UNION SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE 1 = 1 AND TABLE_NAME = :TABLE_NAME ORDER BY PARAM_NAME

SELECT NVL(MAX(PARAM_INDEX), 0) PARAM_INDEX FROM ( SELECT PROGRAM_REV, MAX(PROGRAM_REV) OVER (PARTITION BY FACTORY, PROGRAM) MAX_REV, PARAM_INDEX FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM AND TABLE_NAME = :TABLE_NAME ) WHERE PROGRAM_REV = MAX_REV
-- Create Date : 2019-07-11 15:52:36 SELECT NVL(MAX(PROGRAM_REV), 0) PROGRAM_REV FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY = :FACTORY AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM

-- Create Date : 2019-07-22 16:13:15 SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE (FACTORY, PROGRAM, PROGRAM_REV) IN ( SELECT FACTORY, PROGRAM, PROGRAM_REV FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE WAFER_SEQ = :waferseq ) AND PARAM_NAME = 'BIN'
SELECT DISTINCT PROGRAM FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 AND TABLE_NAME != 'TD_' ORDER BY PROGRAM
SELECT A.* FROM TQP_PARASPEC A, ALL_TAB_COLUMNS B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PROGRAM = :pgm AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.PARAM_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME
SELECT ?? FROM ?? WHERE 1 = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT TABLE_NAME, MAX (FACTORY) AS FACTORY, MAX (PROGRAM) AS PROGRAM, MAX (PROGRAM_REV) AS PROGRAM_REV, MAX (PARAM_INDEX) AS PARAM_INDEX FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1 = 1 and TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL group by TABLE_NAME

-- Create Date : 2019-09-03 14:32:55 SELECT TABLE_NAME, PARAM_NAME FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE (PROGRAM, TABLE_NAME) IN ( SELECT PROGRAM, TABLE_NAME FROM TQP_DATA_TABLES WHERE PROGRAM = :PROGRAM ) AND PARAM_INDEX > 0 ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, PARAM_NAME
-- Create Date : 2019-09-05 13:23:07 SELECT PARAM_NAME FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE FACTORY = :FACTORY AND PROGRAM = :PROGRAM AND TABLE_NAME = :TABLE_NAME ORDER BY PARAM_INDEX
-- Create Date : 2019-09-09 09:46:38 SELECT * FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND PROGRAM = :program AND PROGRAM_REV = :rev ORDER BY PARAM_INDEX ASC

WITH WT AS ( SELECT A.* FROM TQP_PARASPEC A, TQP_WAFER B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PROGRAM = :pgm AND B.WAFER_SEQ IN( ?? ) AND A.PARAM_TYPE IN ('FLOAT', 'INT' ) AND A.PROGRAM_REV = B.PROGRAM_REV AND A.TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT A.* FROM WT A, ALL_TAB_COLUMNS B WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.PARAM_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY A.PARAM_NAME
DELETE FROM TQP_PARASPEC WHERE TABLE_NAME = :TABLE_NAME
